texture: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: seamless PBR base-color texture for a realistic dark basalt asteroid in a Unity space-mining game. Create one square 2048x2048 tileable full-frame texture, viewed perfectly orthographically straight at the surface, edge to edge, no objects or background. Cohesive dark charcoal and brown-black fractured basalt, extremely fine sharp mineral grains, subtle mottled mineral composition, tiny pits, irregular fine hairline fissures, a few small flakes and chipped flecks. Mostly continuous stone planes with fine granular texture; texture grain is much smaller than the large rock fractures that the game geometry will supply. Natural high-resolution geological detail. Neutral flat diffuse cross-polarized lighting with no directional illumination baked in, no specular highlights, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no gradients, no vignette. Moderately dark charcoal diffuse color with restrained variation and occasional muted warm gray flecks. This is a usable base-color texture, not a picture of a rock, not a render of gravel, not an asteroid concept board. No metal, no gold, no copper, no glowing cracks, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no frame. Avoid clusters of rounded stones, cobblestones, popcorn bumps, repeating polygon cells and strongly raised-looking forms. Crisp small-scale granular surface structure suitable for realistic close-up game materials.

concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic 3D asteroid concept board for Belt Runner's Unity space-mining game. Create a landscape 16:9 art direction mockup titled only '01 / FRACTURED ROCK'. This is a new visual target, not a screenshot of an existing engine. Main composition: a huge asymmetrical dark basalt asteroid floating against almost black space, sharply resolved and fully visible, with three smaller variations along a clean lower strip. The main asteroid is a single cohesive angular rock mass with a few major shattered planes and deep intersecting geological fractures, chipped knife-edged ledges, craggy silhouette, fine porous mineral grain, crushed edges, tiny pits and varied scale surface detail. Broad naturally exposed copper ore seams cut diagonally THROUGH the rock and lie flush with its surface, showing small irregular planar metal facets and broken boundaries; the ore is noticeably metallic at a distance because it reflects the sun, not because it glows. Small variants: an elongated iron-bearing shard, a compact gold-bearing boulder, a flattened barren slab. Realistic space lighting: one small distant warm-white sun off frame upper left, hard directional shadows in cracks, restrained cool bounced fill so the dark side is barely legible, physically plausible metallic highlights. Stone is near-black brown charcoal with subtle mineral variation, never uniform medium gray. A few distant asteroid silhouettes provide scale without obscuring the specimens. Crisp production-quality game asset visualization, realistic PBR materials, no excessive bloom or depth blur. Avoid piles of gravel glued to a sphere, rounded popcorn bumps, uniformly repeated noise, molten lava, orange emission, glowing cracks, protruding ore nodes, spikes, cartoon style, HUD, Unity editor chrome, watermarks or extra text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic 3D asteroid concept board for Belt Runner's Unity space-mining game. Landscape 16:9 art direction mockup titled only '02 / LAYERED ROCK'. New visual concept, not a real engine screenshot. A large elongated asymmetrical asteroid of dark charcoal rock floats in black space, with three fully visible smaller alternate silhouettes arranged in a neat lower strip. Geological design is the focus: a cohesive rock carved from strong diagonal strata, broad flaking rock shelves, irregular jagged plate edges, deep shear faults between overlapping layers, some large flat fractured surfaces and a few eroded crevices, fine dusty mineral grain and micro-pitting. The silhouette has a heavy blunt end and tapered broken end, no regular symmetry. Wide silver-platinum metal seams with a restrained pale teal mineral tint are embedded flush BETWEEN the stone layers. Exposed crystalline metal planes reflect concentrated white sunlight while adjacent stone remains matte and dark; rich texture and convincing real scale. Lower variations: a thin copper-veined slab, a chunky gold-veined layered boulder, and a dark layered barren rock. Use a small distant warm sun outside the image from upper left, deep realistic occlusion inside cracks, very faint cool ambient bounce, deep space background with sparse stars and a few tiny distant rocks. Photorealistic physically based Unity game art target, finely detailed, cinematic yet readable, clean individual silhouettes. Avoid stacked uniform plates, floating detached chips, spikes, fantasy crystals sticking out, any glowing ore or lava, metal painted over an entire rock, chrome blobs, pebble mosaics, rubble glued together, cartoon visuals, HUD, UI chrome, watermarks or text other than the small title.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic 3D asteroid concept board for Belt Runner's Unity space-mining game. Create a landscape 16:9 visual design mockup titled only '03 / WEATHERED ROCK'. New concept art, not a screenshot of the real game. Main large hero: an irregular ancient dark ironstone asteroid floating in near-black space, with a massive off-center broken concavity and worn impact pits, visibly a solid cohesive rocky body. A mix of broad rugged fracture faces, rounded eroded recesses, sharp fresh chips and fine granular microtexture gives natural multiscale detail. Several large exposed silvery iron facets are integrated flush into the broken face, with irregular branched seams continuing into the stone. Metal catches warm-white sunlight and the rough charcoal-brown stone stays dark and matte. No lava and absolutely no self-lit seams. Three smaller complete variants in a clean lower strip: a lopsided copper-rich rock, a pitted rock with subdued violet reflective mineral seams embedded in its surface, and a barren angular weathered boulder. Clear differences in shape, asymmetrical silhouettes, no uniformly spherical bodies. Strong realistic directional sunlight from upper left, dark cavities with very subtle blue reflected fill, sparse stars and distant belt silhouettes. High-end physically based Unity game art target, near-camera asset detail, crisp natural texture, restrained specular highlights and no bloom haze. Avoid reptile scales, honeycomb patterns, evenly spaced craters, coral/popcorn/gravel-coated spheres, cartoon rocks, glossy stone, protruding ore nodes, spikes, giant external crystals, HUD, engine interface, watermarks and any text except the small title.
